name: Particle-built newsletter-reader intro: dot sphere, particle icons, a dithered dark-to-light wipe and an e-ink ring burst

brand_assets.description: Product wordmark, tagline and address on the end card

rights.notes: Rights unverified. Product intro; reuse the particle-built icons, the dithered wipe and the screen-refresh release only, with original type and content.

analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot, Session E) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (20 frames), transitions sheet (3 boundaries, every 2nd frame of 60 fps), listen sheet (4 phrases and 12 accents) and 30 fps strips at 7.45-7.80 s and 12.45-12.80 s (ffmpeg backend). Music-sync test with measure_frames_batch5.py at 60 fps (frame-difference rising edges, full frame, the headline region and the inbox-list region, against audio onsets and accents within 50 ms, chance = share of the film within 50 ms of an onset); dips and grids from measure_batch5.py. nothing was listened to.
analysis.coverage: Full 15.0 s (1280x720, 60 fps); the wipe and the ring burst at 30 fps.

concept.observed: Introduces a reader that collects newsletters: a sphere of dots breaks into a grid, particle icons show forwarding and saving, a dithered wipe turns dark to light for the collected issue, the issue becomes an e-reader page and an e-ink refresh releases the end card.
concept.interpreted: Dust becomes content becomes a calm page: the medium's texture is the story.

communication_style.observed: Text-led film: the copy is on screen, timed to the music. A numbered kicker and a two-line serif headline with one italic word per section.

palette.observed: Warm near-black (#181818, #282818) for the first half, ivory paper (#f8f8f8, 38%) for the second; white dots; black e-reader bezel.

typography.observed: Light serif headlines with one italic word ('newsletters', 'anywhere', 'quiet', 'e-reader'); tiny mono kicker numbers; serif wordmark on the end card.

composition.observed: Headline left at about 30-45% of the height, 1.5-25% of the width; an inbox list or the issue at right; particle icons drift lower right.

motion.observed: Dots orbit inside a glass sphere (0-1.6 s) and burst into a grid (1.68-1.80 s); a bright band scans the grid (2.0-2.6 s); particles assemble an envelope, a share icon, a link and a signal icon (3.2-6.4 s) while list rows add at right; pages fan behind the issue (8.6-9.4 s); the issue dithers into a device page (9.9-10.4 s).

transitions.observed: 3 boundaries, 0 edits. 2.06 s: continuous (the scan band crosses the grid and it dims to the headline scene). 7.55 s: cover, a grain-edged dither wipe from left, dark to light, about 0.35 s (7.50-7.85 s). 12.50 s: grow, the e-reader screen flashes black (12.50-12.58 s), a particle ring bursts from its centre at 12.62 s and grows past the frame by 12.82 s into the white end card. Also a headline swap in place at 5.10 s and the page-to-device change at 10.10 s.
transitions.interpreted: Every change is made of the same dots, so the film never cuts.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Sections change every 2.40-2.55 s after the opening (2.06, 5.10, 7.55, 10.10, 12.50 s), about four beats at the measured 95.7 bpm (2.51 s).

sound_design.observed: -14.5 LUFS, LRA 5.0 LU, true peak -1.3 dBTP. Tempo 95.7 bpm (medium, autocorr 0.75). 20 accents (80/min), 17 of them on a 0.30-0.33 s grid (2.55-6.62 s and 8.50-9.75 s). Accents on boundaries 0/3 (chance 0.23); onsets on boundaries 0.67 (chance 0.30, median 42 ms), on a beat 0.33 (chance 0.19). Sync test at 60 fps: headline-region changes within 50 ms of an onset 6/10 (chance 0.35), inbox rows 0/5 (chance 0.35), full-frame change starts 6/12 (0.35). Level dips 1.44-2.28 s (-41.9 dB, film median -19.3) before the scan band and 12.68-12.96 s (-47.2 dB) during the ring burst before the end card. Head silence 0.05-0.35 s. Accents may be part of the music.
sound_design.interpreted: Synced at the phrase level (a section per bar, headlines near onsets), not at the hit level (no accent on a transition, list rows off the onsets).

narration.observed: None: 18 raw words, 8 confident in 4 phrases, all one repeated letter, over headlines with no speaker. Engine Windows desktop dictation (System.Speech en-US), rough.

captions.observed: No captions; copy is the two-line headline at left (2-4 words per line, held 2.4-2.5 s) with one italic word, swapped in place.

scenes.observed: A glass sphere of dots bursts into a grid.
Save from anywhere: share, link and signal icons.
Dithered wipe to light: the collected issue and its pages.
The issue arrives on an e-reader.
E-ink flash, ring burst, end card.

moments.observed: The e-reader screen goes black for 0.08 s, a ring of particles bursts from its centre (12.62 s) and grows past the frame (12.82 s) while the level drops 28 dB under the median (12.68-12.96 s).
moments.interpreted: An e-ink refresh used as the release into the end card.

difficult: Thousands of dots assembling icons need a particle system with sampled targets (Canvas 2D is enough)
The glass sphere looks rendered (refraction and a soft shadow)
uncertainties: Whether the title's 'synced to music' means a hand edit to bars; frame-difference events under-detect arrivals in continuous particle motion
Whether the opening sphere is a 3D render or a 2D treatment
